templates.pattern: A wave has a frequency of [F] Hz and a wavelength of [L] m. What is its wave speed?
A wave travels at [V] m/s and has a wavelength of [L] m. What is its frequency?
A wave has a speed of [V] m/s and a frequency of [F] Hz. What is its wavelength?
A sound wave travels [D] m in [T] seconds through air. What is the speed of sound in this medium?
A wave completes [N] full oscillations in [T] seconds. What is its frequency?
templates.explanation: Frequency = number of oscillations ÷ time = [N] ÷ [T] = [RESULT] Hz

templates.pattern: A wave has a frequency of [F] Hz. What is its time period?
A person shouts near a cliff and hears the echo after [T] seconds. The speed of sound is [V] m/s. How far away is the cliff?
templates.explanation: Sound travels to the cliff and back. Distance = (speed × time) ÷ 2 = ([V] × [T]) ÷ 2 = [V*T] ÷ 2 = [RESULT] m

templates.pattern: A wave has an amplitude of [A] cm and a wavelength of [L] m. If the frequency doubles, what happens to the wave speed? Choose the correct statement.
templates.explanation: Wave speed depends on the medium, not on frequency or amplitude. Doubling the frequency halves the wavelength but wave speed stays the same.

templates.pattern: Ultrasound of frequency [F] kHz travels at [V] m/s in soft tissue. What is its wavelength in millimetres?
The distance between two successive crests of a water wave is [L] m. The wave passes a fixed point every [T] seconds. What is the wave speed?
templates.explanation: The distance between successive crests is the wavelength. Wave speed = wavelength ÷ period = [L] ÷ [T] = [RESULT] m/s
